QE1_no_predicate_substitution._note: The join no longer substitutes a bound PREDICATE: same rows, but every left solution scans every triple. Type-preserving: an impossible type tag.

QE2_no_fromBinding_mark._note: The substituted predicate is not marked fromBinding — it is widened like a constant.

QE3_bind_iri_as_string._note: The marked BIND(<iri>) still binds the string (the consumer half of PT4).

QE4_subquery_scope_ignored._note: A subquery's unprojected variables are substituted again (the pre-review behaviour): a leading BIND captures a variable the subquery does not project. Type-preserving (`length < 0`, never true).
